page_title: Swiss Alpine Wonderland | Alpen Glow Tours and Travels
title: Swiss Alpine Wonderland
overview_paragraphs: Switzerland's Alps look exactly like the postcards because the postcards are barely exaggerating — jagged snow-capped peaks, emerald valleys, and mountain trains that climb to viewpoints most countries would need a helicopter to reach. This trip rides the country's legendary scenic railways through its most dramatic alpine scenery.
Built for travelers who want maximum alpine scenery delivered comfortably by train, with minimal hiking required.

itinerary.title: Zurich & Lucerne
itinerary.desc: Arrive in Zurich, then continue to Lucerne for the Chapel Bridge, Lake Lucerne, and a cable car up Mount Pilatus.

itinerary.title: Interlaken & Jungfraujoch
itinerary.desc: Scenic train to Interlaken, gateway to the Jungfrau region, with a ride to Jungfraujoch — the 'Top of Europe' — for views over the Aletsch Glacier.

itinerary.title: Zermatt & the Matterhorn
itinerary.desc: Continue by train to Zermatt for unobstructed views of the iconic Matterhorn, with a ride up the Gornergrat railway.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Scenic train back to Zurich or Geneva for your international departure.

inclusions: Swiss Travel Pass for train travel
